Show the nonlocal keyword with a nested function.

Supplied answer
def outer():
    x = "surya"
    def inner():
        nonlocal x # use the outer function's x
        x = "kanta"
    inner()
    return x
print(outer()) # kanta
Note: global reaches the module level; nonlocal reaches the enclosing function.
